verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY after work (around 16:30) at Rey Cortiço could be the best available option, but I wouldn’t commit without a camera check first. The wind looks like the main problem for this spot, and Surfline consistency isn’t great, so it can get messy fast depending on the sandbanks. Check Surfline and MEO Beachcam before you go—if it doesn’t look clearly better than expected, I’d skip it. If the cams look clean and organized, then you’ve got a chance for something workable.

Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; wind angle is poor for this spot.
